first.rationale: Targeted promotional pricing most directly addresses the immediate loss of price-sensitive SMBs, but the inherited evidence establishes acquisition and revenue lift without confirming retention, post-promotion conversion, or long-term account quality. Verify memory_73 for sustainable qualified-revenue evidence and memory_86 as the strongest alternative tied to the simultaneous onboarding and activation declines. Pending verification, use only a guarded, tightly targeted pricing test rather than a broad discount rollout.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying the onboarding flow. The verified source directly addresses the current 4% completion decline and showed completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, aligning with sustainable qualified revenue. Reject promotional pricing because its verified cohort had 30-day retention -12% and failed to survive the first renewal cycle. Preserve uncertainty by testing rather than broadly rolling out, since current-quarter conditions may differ from the archived experiment.
